record.body:
## Basis

Claude Code hooks docs (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks), JSON output section, read 2026-10-29. Observed the same day: a 16,680-character handoff arrived as a 2,000-character preview plus a tool-results file path.

payload.statement: Claude Code caps each hook additionalContext string at 10,000 characters. Above the cap the agent gets a 2,000-character preview and a file path, and is not told to read it. No setting raises the cap.

record.subject: claude-code-hook-context-cap
